## Pick: `1` (merge)

All merge preconditions hold:
- There are no blockers.
- CI evidence binds to the assessed head.
- The only material claim is matched.
- `mergeable` is MERGEABLE and `merge_state_status` is CLEAN.
- The worktree is tracked-clean.

Squash is the default policy. I ran these commands in order:

```bash
# Compare-and-swap freshness read
gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,body,baseRefName
gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=210

# Full comment refetch and reconciliation before the merge (Re-render steps 1-5)
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/210/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/210/comments --paginate

# Merge policy allowed
gh api repos/acme/widgets --jq '{allow_squash_merge,allow_merge_commit,allow_rebase_merge}'

# Merge (not BLOCKED, so no --admin)
gh pr merge 210 -R acme/widgets --match-head-commit <assessed headRefOid> --squash

# Post-merge state
gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json state,mergeCommit
```

The final read returned `state: MERGED` and `mergeCommit.oid 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978`. I recorded both in `pr.state` and `pr.merge_commit`.
